description: Daily open-to-open rebalancing on the engine's filtered sentiment, 5 bp per unit of turnover; benchmark = the same 20 stocks equally weighted with the same costs. Headlines are only usable from the next day's open. One year, 20 stocks: a small sample, so read the IC t-statistic before reading the return.

metric_notes.Mean daily IC: rank corr. of signal with next-day return
